limitations: ANATOMICAL leg only: wiring geometry, NOT an operating point (L164).
Operator powers are walks WITH revisits, not paths.
r_d = A^d 1 is source-FREE in the undecomposed legs — the depth-d generalisation of in-mass, not a per-actor reach.

The d_cross point estimates for beta and Crofts were derivable from l216/static.json before this card ran and are DESCRIPTION (Kriegeskorte 2009; PREREG 0b states all six series in full). The NULL for the Ti-minus-Tr gap, the entire rw leg, the source decomposition and the cord restriction are the unobserved objects.
The source decomposition attributes a walk to its ORIGIN, not to its last hop: a cord-origin walk may traverse descending cells.
rw normalises by out-strength and therefore DOWN-weights hub sources by construction — a sign agreement with beta is informative, a magnitude comparison between operators is not.
d=8 is a near-asymptotic probe, not the asymptote; the pre-asymptotic residue |A_cell(8) - A_inf| is reported for every cell.
rw_in is excluded unconditionally (PREREG amendment 0a-i), not because it measured badly.
super_class labels come from the BANC annotation table; a root id appearing twice resolves to its last row, and unlabelled nodes fall in the 'other' group rather than being dropped.
No neuromere column exists on BANC, so no legblock tier is possible.
